item.title: Version 0.11.0
item.description: Sequence: fixed the Add Bar crash; click the timeline to place a playhead (Today returns to now) with a red line for the real time; a + button on every workstream to add a bar, milestone or task, with grouped Bars / Milestones / Tasks lists and notes on every item and bar; the detail panel floats so nothing moves when it opens; drag to resize the left rail, workstream column and detail panel; sidebar selector like Notes; colour dot is display only; dropdown only when a workstream has content
